methods.primary: All five arms: 64 Adam updates, B4, constant LR .003, gradient clip 1, BCE, depth 2.
methods.regularization: Aux = BCE + .05 sum(channel squared error)/sum(channel squared magnitude).
methods.secondary: Depth3 and 96/128 parity checkpoints use all 3 pairs. LR, warmcos, aux, unclipped use pair 901 in each regime.
methods.warmcos: Updates 1-4 warm from .25x to 1x LR. Following updates decay from 1x to .1x over remaining 60 updates.
methods.counts: Raw payload coded-bit errors, decoded LDPC block errors, and total squared channel error and energy pooled over frames.
methods.classical: genie_pa receives the realized PAState for R1. All other reference methods use the observation.
methods.fixed: Archived independent P5-B Fixed and Fixed+Parity receivers at depth 2.
methods.curves: At each curve checkpoint, all arms use a separate B8 simulation with the same stream-6 base seed as primary B32 scoring. These B8 draws are not assumed to be a subset of B32. Training values average the preceding 16 B4 updates. Curves average equal-size pair samples.
methods.fit_time: One PyTorch thread per worker, frame simulation through optimizer update. Validation, probe, timing and checkpoint I/O excluded. Parallel jobs can share machine resources.
methods.latency: Serial, one PyTorch thread. End-to-end receiver forward excluding simulation and final LDPC decode. Use pair 901 step-64 checkpoints; one warmup and five timed repeats per batch/arm.
methods.probe: Full Green target for pure and parity attention arms. The local signed depthwise kernels have no scalar softmax attention matrix. Overall Pearson excludes diagonal. Axis-only restricts to coordinate pairs differing only on that axis. Shuffle permutes keys eight times per layer. Each pair is a mean over bursts and EM steps. Null denotes undefined Pearson.
methods.baseline_comparison: The initial reference check with 4 batches of 8 gave R1/R2/R3 Fixed+Parity counts 31/438/65. A separate check at the first stream-6 seed with one batch of 32 reproduced all three provided fixed-parity totals. The benchmark adopted that B32 partition across all arms and ablations before inspecting trained results. Equality of aggregate counts does not establish individual frame identity with the supplied oracle run. No oracle outputs were recomputed.
methods.budget_selection: For each parity arm separately, minimize pooled development BLER or BCE over checkpoints 64/96/128 of the identical constant-LR trajectory. Ties favor fewer updates. No confirmatory claim or protocol selection.

physical_handle_ablation.interpretation: Each omitted output is zeroed after physical projection at every EM step; subsequent states and predictions are recomputed with the same trained weights. Effects may interact and need not add. The PA intervention also removes the variance term tied to its radial coefficients; variance alone removes the free log-variance output.
